subject.title: [Bug]: CLI relay exits silently with code 1 when session lane is blocked — no timeout or busy error surfaced

question: What CLI contract should lane-busy waits use before the linked fix lands?
rationale: The core bug is clear, but changing the exit code or adding a queue-control flag is a user-visible CLI contract decision beyond source-level repair.

options.title: Render busy error, keep exit 1
options.body: Surface structured stderr and JSON error details while preserving the existing generic nonzero exit behavior for compatibility.

options.title: Use a distinct tempfail code
options.body: Return a documented code such as 75 so orchestration scripts can branch on lane-busy failures.

options.title: Broaden into queue controls
options.body: Expand the fix to include an explicit queue/wait option, accepting a larger CLI product surface.

recommendation.title: Render busy error, keep exit 1
recommendation.body: Surface structured stderr and JSON error details while preserving the existing generic nonzero exit behavior for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest overlap across CLI, Gateway, and queue surfaces affected by the contract choice.
